Front Page · Fruit Bowl Secrets

Lulu the Lemon Makes Her Debut

A brand-new face joins the Fruit Bowl today — and she arrives carrying a honey jar, a gentle heart, and a lesson nobody in the bowl will forget.

From the Gazette Newsroom · Tuesday, November 10, 2026

Fruit Bowl Secrets Episode 6, “Sour Face, Sweet Heart,” was built and quality-checked on November 9 and is slated to land on Facebook at 5:08 PM today as part of the bonus-push recovery.

It introduces Lulu the Lemon, a brand-new character who carries her honey jar everywhere — sweet, not sour.

Gigi judges Lulu by her sour face, then learns never to judge a fruit by her peel.

Set your reminders: the debut goes out at 5:08 PM today, right in the middle of a full recovery day on the Hub. Full details from the Around the Hub desk, below.
